commandId.description: The client-generated UUID every command takes; a retry with the same id applies once.

connectionId.description: A key-manager connection's id: a version 4 UUID the adding client mints, kept in lowercase.

provider.description: A key manager's provider: openbao (OpenBao or Vault), doppler, onepassword (1Password) or bitwarden (Bitwarden Secrets Manager).

label.description: A key-manager connection's label, which people know it by: 1 to 100 characters on one line.

address.description: The key manager's URL: only its origin is kept.

ca.description: The CA to pin, as PEM, which a person accepted; absent for none. OpenBao only.

method.description: How it signs in; preset: the credential's method. OpenBao only, and required there without a credential.

mount.description: Where the method is mounted; preset: the method's name. OpenBao only.

username.description: The username of a userpass login, which it requires.

tokenRole.description: The token role run tokens are created against. OpenBao only.

ticks.description: The policies runs receive, as a copy carries them; preset: every policy of the login, at the first sign-in.

items.description: An OpenBao or Vault policy's name: on one line, no comma, and never root, which the harness never holds.

basePath.description: Where Move keeps the harness's secrets, as a copy carries it.

copiedFrom.description: The environment a copy was made from; absent for a connection added here.

environmentId.description: An environment's persistent id: a UUID made on its first start, kept across address changes.

environmentName.description: The source environment's name when the copy was made.

importedFrom.description: The id the state import's source gave the connection; absent for one not imported.

credential.description: The credential, sent once; absent for a copy or an import, which waits for a sign-in.

oneOf.description: An AppRole's role id and secret id.

password.description: The userpass password: printable, on one line.

oneOf.description: A userpass password; the username is the connection's.
A token, looked up to sign in.
